summary: John's 4th-great-grand-aunt (sister of Elizabeth Croup Pringle) - independent proof of Frederick and Mary (Young) Croup.
bio: Susan Croup was born at Nanticoke (WikiTree: Shickshinny) in May 1800 and died at Plymouth in 1863; Harvey calls her 'daughter of Frederick and Mary (Young) Croup'. She married Philip Shupp Jr. (1791-1833), co-operator of Col. Philip Shupp's grist mill, Plymouth's principal mill from about 1808. Buried Shawnee Cemetery, Plymouth (Find a Grave 75273513). Children Mary (Shupp) Nesbitt (b. 1820; to Rolling Prairie, Indiana, 1853) and Peter Shupp (1822-1897).
